name: Aram
overview: Aram is a male figure identified as a member of the tribe of Asher. He is uniquely noted in Scripture as the son of Shomer, establishing his genealogical position within the tribe. No additional personal or ministerial details are provided about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Aram is presented as a proper name in Scripture without an explicit meaning or divine origin. Therefore, it is simply recognized as the personal name given to this individual without further significance noted.
familyAndRelationships: Aram is explicitly recorded as the son of Shomer, which situates him within a specific family lineage in the tribe of Asher. Beyond this paternal relationship, Scripture does not provide additional family details for Aram.
scriptureSignificance: Aram’s significance lies primarily in his genealogical mention, which contributes to the broader biblical record of the tribe of Asher’s descendants. His identification as Shomer’s son helps preserve the historical and tribal lineage important for understanding Israel’s tribal structure. Though brief, this reference supports the continuity of God’s covenant people as recorded in the Old Testament.
